bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet has levered up post-acquisition: Debt-Equity of 0.93 in Q1 FY27 versus 0.35 in FY24 and 0.79 in FY25; Total Debt to Total Assets 0.43 versus 0.23 in FY24.
- Large liquidity pool retained — Cash & Cash equivalents, Investments & Other financial assets of ₹1,96,716 lakhs at Q1 FY27 against Total Equity of ₹1,77,550 lakhs.
- Coverage remains intact despite leverage: DSCR 5.47 and ISCR 4.17 in Q1 FY27 (ISCR was 8.97 in FY24); Current Assets to Current Liabilities 1.66 versus 3.14 in FY24.
- Working-capital discipline: Total DSO of 92 days in Q1 FY27 (Billed 55, Unbilled 37) versus 94 in FY26 and 87 in FY24.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Self-described as "AI First customer-obsessed digital engineering and Mindful IT company"; IPO in September 2020, completed 15 years in March 2026, with ~700,000 shareholders.
- Client franchise of 300+ Active Clients and 90+ Fortune2000 / Forbes200 Billion $ Corporations, with 94.4% Repeat Business; the data sheet shows # Billion $ Corporation rising from 61 (FY24) to 92 (Q1 FY27).
- Positions AI as structural, not a bolt-on: "GenAI and Agentic AI are core to how we design, build, and deliver solutions", with end-to-end Agentic AI capabilities spanning AI assistants, domain copilots, AI-native platforms, ITSM, cybersecurity and operations.
- Third-party validation cited: ISG Digital Engineering Services (Midsize) 2026 Product Challenger ratings in US and Europe, Avasant Challenger in Banking, High-Tech and Manufacturing Digital Services 2026 RadarView, and Everest Top 50 Store Services Providers 2026.
- Mission "Happiest People, Happiest Customers" with SMILES values (Sharing, Mindful, Integrity, Learning, Excellence, Social Responsibility).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisitions] Goodwill jumped from ₹14,032 lakhs (FY24) to ₹76,230 lakhs (FY25) and stands at ₹77,703 lakhs at Q1 FY27; the deck notes "Amortization/Unwinding interest are non-cash items related to acquisitions" and that Adjusted PAT is adjusted for exceptional items and amortization of intangibles.
- [Wage code] An exceptional item described as "New wage code cost" appears in FY26 (₹1,859 lakhs) with quarterly entries of ₹2,203 lakhs in Q3 FY26 and ₹(344) lakhs in Q4 FY26; nil in Q1 FY27.
- [Leadership] Founder Ashok Soota recognized in the AIM 100 under the Specialist Forces category; Preeti Menon recognized among the AIM Top 24 Women Enterprise AI Leaders in India.
- [Client wins] Named engagements include a multi-year, multi-million-dollar Managed Security Services deal with a Middle Eastern retailer, and selection as strategic Data & AI partner for a N. American energy infrastructure company covering data platforms, pipelines and the Power BI/reporting estate.
- [Concentration] Top 5 clients 28.4%, Top 10 42.1%, Top 20 58.3% of revenue; customers older than 5 years contribute 42% of revenue in FY26 versus 48% in FY24.

deepdive.thesis: Happiest Minds delivered a strong Q4 performance with revenue growth of 12.3% YoY, driven by increasing adoption of AI-led services and digital transformation, with a strong pipeline and improving customer engagement, positioning the company for sustained growth in FY27.
